organization: Centro de Ciencia del Clima y la Resiliencia (CR2)

recommended_message: Offer Talaix API and evidence-labelled data layers as an operational data source for CR2's applied climate-impact research and stakeholder services.
fit_score: CR2 is a national climate and resilience research center; its mandate to connect climate science with Chilean stakeholders fits Talaix data products.
